title: Large Language Models as Superpositions of Cultural Perspectives
benchmark_measurement: The study measured how an LLM's expressed values, including the 'Tradition' value (partially defined by religious customs), shifted when its context was changed. This included exposing the model to paragraphs about gospel music or prompting it to act as an AI expert in gospel music, and observing the resulting changes in its answers to psychological questionnaires.
findings: Exposing an LLM to a religion-related context, such as a paragraph about gospel music or prompting it to be an AI expert on the topic, caused significant and unexpected shifts in the model's expressed values. For instance, the perspective of an AI expert in gospel music led the model to express a higher 'Tradition' value compared to other music expert perspectives.
